name: Nicole
source:
Nicole is a very career-focused young woman, and is already a full partner at a prestigious law-firm. She met and started dating [url=/c100642]Protagonist[/url] at Law School. She has high hopes for him to be a partner at a law firm in town someday too. Both are paying off the mortgage on their first apartment.

Her parents are both retired and they are former lawyers. Nicole also has an older sister ([url=/c89514]Georgina[/url]).
